newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: VMC falls to new low as troubles continue.
newsitem.headline: VMC falls to new low as troubles continue.

text.p: Sugar miller Victorias Milling Co Inc fell to a new low of 1.60 pesos by late session on Tuesday as its financial troubles seemed to have spread to its subsidiary, brokers said.
The company lost 10 centavos or 5.99 percent amidst moderate trading.
"The troubles just keep coming," one broker said.
The latest to rock the company was its trading arm North Negros Marketing Co Inc seeking the government's help to shield it from its creditors.
North Negros has liabilities of 2.196 billion pesos against assets of only 2.1 billion.
Victorias itself had earlier sought for a moratorium on the principal payment of its 4.423 billion peso debt from 32 local and foreign creditors.
Negotiations for a debt restructuring have hit a snag, prompting some banks to threaten to file foreclosure proceedings.
